com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.component

Interface IComponent

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IIdentifiable, IModelAbstraction

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IComponent
extends IIdentifiable
    A IComponent represents a software component prototype in the flat extract according to AUTOSAR. A IComponent has a IComponentType which represents the software component type. The corresponding name element in programming languages is an `Instance` and a `Class`.
